resources.string: AppOps state unavailable on this ROM.
Android reported no AppOps entries for this package.

AppOps are separate from manifest permissions. This section is an audit only and nothing is changed. uid is the mode set for the app uid, package is the mode set for this package. If Android output cannot be split reliably, every reported mode is listed instead. OEM operations such as MIUIOP(n) are shown read-only. Check the raw output for the exact text.
